trossos.ca:
Ovella Negra forma part de l'ecosistema de
    partners i col·laboradors que fan possible el CB Grup Barna, el club de bàsquet base del Clot,
    Barcelona. Segueix-los: cada follow que reben des del club forma part del que els oferim a canvi.
trossos.en: Ovella Negra is part of the ecosystem of partners and collaborators that make CB Grup Barna possible, the youth basketball club of the Clot, Barcelona. Follow them: every follow they get through the club is part of what we offer them in return.

trossos.en: L'Ovella Negra is a bar run by the Ovella Negra group in Poblenou (Sant Martí), in a former industrial building of more than 2,000 m². It serves craft beer, sangria, tapas, sandwiches and burgers, and has table football and pool.

trossos.ca: Oferta per a la família del Barna
Ovella Negra encara no té cap avantatge publicat per a la família del Barna. Si en vols oferir un, escriu-nos i el publiquem aquí.
trossos.en: Ovella Negra does not yet have any offer published for Barna families. If you would like to offer one, write to us and we will publish it here.

trossos.ca: Encara no tenim posts concrets seleccionats per incrustar aquí. Mentrestant, segueix-los directament.
